# Naija Career Compass AI

> A free, private career guide for Nigerian secondary school students, built by Yewa College ByteBusters (Generative AI Team). Students answer 9 questions about what they enjoy and the AI suggests 3 careers, each with subjects to focus on and real Nigerian routes.

## What it does
- Suggests exactly 3 careers. Every set includes at least one university route (JAMB/UTME) and one skilled trade (NABTEB, NSQ or apprenticeship); polytechnic (ND/HND) and college of education (NCE) routes are also used.
- Writes the results in 17 Nigerian languages: English, Hausa, Yoruba, Igbo, Pidgin, Fulfulde, Kanuri, Tiv, Ibibio, Efik, Izon, Edo, Nupe, Urhobo, Igala, Idoma and Ebira. Career titles and exam names stay in English.
- "Talk to my parents": writes a short, respectful message in the parents' language about one career, with answers to common parental worries, ready to copy or send on WhatsApp.
- Skilled-trade careers link to their training page on Apprentice Pathways Explorer (https://apprentice-pathway-explorer.vercel.app/).
- No sign-up and nothing is saved. A privacy filter removes names, ages, phone numbers, emails and ID numbers before anything reaches the AI.
- Guardrails: never promises a salary or job, and never says a career is not for someone because of who they are.

## Tools
- [Class Mode](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/class/): free class codes for teachers; students use the career form and teachers see anonymous totals of career families, routes and subjects (no names or answers stored)

## Career guides (one page each: what they do, subjects, route, how long)
- [How to become a Medical Doctor in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/medical-doctor/): A medical doctor finds out what is making people sick and treats them, in hospitals, clinics and communities. Route: University. Time: 6 years of study, plus 1 year housemanship. UTME: English, Physics, Chemistry, Biology.
- [How to become a Pharmacist in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/pharmacist/): A pharmacist is the expert on medicines: how they are made, how they work and how to use them safely. Route: University. Time: 5 to 6 years, plus 1 year internship. UTME: English, Physics, Chemistry, Biology.
- [How to become a Nurse in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/nurse/): A nurse cares for patients every day: giving treatment, watching their progress and comforting families. Route: University. Time: 5 years at university, or about 3 to 4 years at a College of Nursing. UTME: English, Physics, Chemistry, Biology.
- [How to become a Medical Laboratory Scientist in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/medical-laboratory-scientist/): A medical laboratory scientist tests blood and other samples so doctors know exactly what is wrong. Route: University. Time: 5 years, plus 1 year internship. UTME: English, Physics, Chemistry, Biology.
- [How to become a Physiotherapist in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/physiotherapist/): A physiotherapist helps people move again after injury, stroke or surgery, using exercise and hands-on treatment. Route: University. Time: 5 to 6 years, plus 1 year internship. UTME: English, Physics, Chemistry, Biology.
- [How to become a Dentist in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/dentist/): A dentist looks after teeth, gums and the mouth, from check-ups to surgery. Route: University. Time: 6 years, plus 1 year housemanship. UTME: English, Physics, Chemistry, Biology.
- [How to become an Optometrist in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/optometrist/): An optometrist tests eyesight, prescribes glasses and spots eye problems early. Route: University. Time: 6 years, plus 1 year internship. UTME: English, Physics, Chemistry, Biology.
- [How to become a Radiographer in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/radiographer/): A radiographer takes X-rays, scans and other images that let doctors see inside the body. Route: University. Time: 5 years, plus 1 year internship. UTME: English, Physics, Chemistry, Biology.
- [How to become a Veterinary Doctor in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/veterinary-doctor/): A veterinary doctor keeps animals healthy: pets, poultry, cattle and wildlife. This also protects people's food. Route: University. Time: 6 years. UTME: English, Physics, Chemistry, Biology.
- [How to become a Nutritionist or Dietitian in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/nutritionist-dietitian/): A nutritionist or dietitian plans what people should eat to stay healthy or recover from illness. Route: University. Time: 4 to 5 years. UTME: English, Chemistry, Biology, Mathematics or Physics.
- [How to become a Community Health Extension Worker (CHEW) in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/community-health-worker/): A community health worker gives basic treatment, immunisation and health teaching in towns and villages, often at a primary health centre. Route: Polytechnic or College. Time: About 2 to 3 years.
- [How to become a Pharmacy Technician in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/pharmacy-technician/): A pharmacy technician works with a pharmacist to prepare and give out medicines correctly. Route: Polytechnic or College. Time: About 3 years.
- [How to become a Lawyer in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/lawyer/): A lawyer advises people and organisations about the law and speaks for them in court. Route: University. Time: 5 years, plus about 1 year at the Nigerian Law School. UTME: English, Literature in English, Government or History, One other Arts or Social Science subject.
- [How to become an Accountant in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/accountant/): An accountant records and checks money so that businesses, schools and governments know what they have and spend it properly. Route: University. Time: 4 years at university; professional exams are extra. UTME: English, Mathematics, Economics, One other Social Science subject.
- [How to become an Economist in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/economist/): An economist studies how people, businesses and countries use money and resources, and advises on decisions like prices and jobs. Route: University. Time: 4 years. UTME: English, Mathematics, Economics, Government, Geography or another Social Science subject.
- [How to become a Banker in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/banker/): A banker helps people and businesses save, borrow and move money safely. Route: University. Time: 4 years (degree) or ND and HND. UTME: English, Mathematics, Economics, One other Social Science subject.
- [How to become an Entrepreneur (Business Owner) in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/entrepreneur/): An entrepreneur spots a problem people will pay to solve, and builds a business around it. Route: Polytechnic or College. Time: It is a lifelong learning path.
- [How to become a Teacher in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/teacher/): A teacher helps learners understand subjects and grow in character. Every other career starts with one. Route: University. Time: 3 years (NCE) or 4 years (B.Ed). UTME: English, Two subjects you want to teach, One other relevant subject.
- [How to become a Psychologist or Counsellor in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/psychologist/): A psychologist or counsellor studies how people think and feel, and helps them through difficult times and decisions. Route: University. Time: 4 years, more for clinical practice. UTME: English, Any three subjects (Biology helps).
- [How to become a Social Worker in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/social-worker/): A social worker supports children, families and vulnerable people to get help and stay safe. Route: University. Time: 4 years. UTME: English, Any three Arts or Social Science subjects.
- [How to become a Journalist or Broadcaster in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/journalist/): A journalist finds out what is true and tells the public clearly, on radio, TV, in print or online. Route: University. Time: 4 years (degree) or ND and HND. UTME: English, Literature in English, Government or Economics, One other Arts or Social Science subject.
- [How to become a Civil Engineer in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/civil-engineer/): A civil engineer designs and supervises roads, bridges, buildings, dams and water systems. Route: University. Time: 5 years. UTME: English, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry.
- [How to become a Mechanical Engineer in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/mechanical-engineer/): A mechanical engineer designs and maintains machines: engines, factory lines, generators and cooling systems. Route: University. Time: 5 years. UTME: English, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry.
- [How to become an Electrical and Electronics Engineer in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/electrical-engineer/): An electrical engineer designs power systems, electronics and communication networks. Route: University. Time: 5 years. UTME: English, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry.
- [How to become a Chemical Engineer in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/chemical-engineer/): A chemical engineer turns raw materials into useful products such as fuel, food, plastics, soap and medicine, at factory scale. Route: University. Time: 5 years. UTME: English, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry.
- [How to become a Petroleum and Gas Engineer in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/petroleum-engineer/): A petroleum engineer works out how to find and bring up oil and gas safely and efficiently. Route: University. Time: 5 years. UTME: English, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry.
- [How to become an Architect in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/architect/): An architect designs buildings that are safe, useful and beautiful. Route: University. Time: About 6 years of study. UTME: English, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Geography or Fine Art.
- [How to become a Quantity Surveyor in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/quantity-surveyor/): A quantity surveyor works out what a building project will cost and keeps it within budget. Route: University. Time: About 5 years. UTME: English, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, Geography or Chemistry.
- [How to become an Estate Surveyor and Valuer in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/estate-surveyor/): An estate surveyor values, manages and sells land and buildings. Route: University. Time: About 5 years. UTME: English, Mathematics, Economics, One other subject.
- [How to become a Land Surveyor (Surveying and Geoinformatics) in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/land-surveyor/): A land surveyor measures land accurately and makes the maps used for roads, buildings and boundaries. Route: Polytechnic or College. Time: ND 2 years and HND 2 years, or a 5-year degree. UTME: English, Mathematics, Physics, Geography or Chemistry.
- [How to become a Building Technologist (Builder) in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/building-technologist/): A builder manages the actual construction on site so that the building matches the drawings and is safe. Route: Polytechnic or College. Time: ND 2 years and HND 2 years, or a 5-year degree. UTME: English, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry.
- [How to become a Software Developer in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/software-developer/): A software developer writes the code behind apps, websites and games. Route: University. Time: 4 years (degree); skills can start now. UTME: English, Mathematics, Physics, One other Science subject.
- [How to become a Data Analyst in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/data-analyst/): A data analyst turns numbers into answers that help organisations decide what to do. Route: University. Time: 4 years (degree); skills can start now. UTME: English, Mathematics, Two of Physics, Chemistry and Economics.
- [How to become a Cybersecurity Analyst in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/cybersecurity-analyst/): A cybersecurity analyst protects computers, phones and networks from hackers and scams. Route: University. Time: 4 years (degree); skills can start now. UTME: English, Mathematics, Physics, One other Science subject.
- [How to become a Computer Engineering Technologist in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/computer-hardware-engineer/): A computer engineering technologist builds, installs and repairs computers and networks. Route: Polytechnic or College. Time: ND 2 years and HND 2 years. UTME: English, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry.
- [How to become a Graphic Designer in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/graphic-designer/): A graphic designer creates logos, posters, packaging and social media designs that make messages clear. Route: Polytechnic or College. Time: ND 2 years; skills can start now.
- [How to become an Agricultural Scientist in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/agronomist/): An agricultural scientist helps farmers grow more and better food through soil, seed and pest knowledge. Route: University. Time: 5 years. UTME: English, Chemistry, Biology or Agricultural Science, Mathematics or Physics.
- [How to become a Food Scientist in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/food-scientist/): A food scientist makes sure packaged food is safe, tasty and lasts, and invents new products. Route: University. Time: 5 years (degree) or ND and HND. UTME: English, Chemistry, Mathematics or Physics, Biology or Agricultural Science.
- [How to become a Microbiologist in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/microbiologist/): A microbiologist studies tiny living things like bacteria and fungi, for health, food and the environment. Route: University. Time: 4 years. UTME: English, Biology, Chemistry, Physics or Mathematics.
- [How to become a Biochemist in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/biochemist/): A biochemist studies the chemistry inside living things, which leads to new medicines, tests and foods. Route: University. Time: 4 years. UTME: English, Biology, Chemistry, Physics or Mathematics.
- [How to become a Geologist in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/geologist/): A geologist studies rocks and the Earth to find water, minerals and safe ground for building. Route: University. Time: 4 years. UTME: English, Two of Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics, Biology or Geography.
- [How to become a Statistician in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/statistician/): A statistician designs surveys and makes sense of data so that decisions rest on evidence. Route: University. Time: 4 years (degree) or ND and HND. UTME: English, Mathematics, Two of Physics, Chemistry and Economics.
- [How to become a Science Laboratory Technologist in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/science-laboratory-technologist/): A science laboratory technologist runs the equipment and tests in school, hospital and industrial laboratories. Route: Polytechnic or College. Time: ND 2 years and HND 2 years. UTME: English, Physics, Chemistry, Biology.
- [How to become a Pilot in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/pilot/): A pilot flies aircraft and is responsible for the safety of everyone on board. Route: Polytechnic or College. Time: About 2 years of flight training, then experience.
- [How to become a Seafarer or Marine Engineer in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/marine-engineer/): A marine engineer keeps a ship's engines and systems running at sea and in port. Route: Polytechnic or College. Time: About 4 years including sea-time. UTME: English, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry.
- [How to become a Hotel and Hospitality Manager in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/hospitality-manager/): A hospitality manager runs hotels, restaurants and events so that guests are well looked after. Route: Polytechnic or College. Time: ND 2 years and HND 2 years.
- [How to become an Electrician in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/electrician/): An electrician installs and repairs the wiring, sockets and lights that bring power safely into buildings. Route: Skilled trade. Time: About 2 to 4 years.
- [How to become a Solar Installer in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/solar-installer/): A solar installer fits panels, batteries and inverters so homes and shops get power from the sun. Route: Skilled trade. Time: About 1 to 3 years.
- [How to become a Welder and Fabricator in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/welder/): A welder joins metal to make gates, tanks, frames and machine parts. Route: Skilled trade. Time: About 2 to 4 years.
- [How to become a Plumber in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/plumber/): A plumber installs and repairs the pipes that bring clean water in and take waste water out. Route: Skilled trade. Time: About 2 to 3 years.
- [How to become an Auto Mechanic in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/auto-mechanic/): An auto mechanic finds faults in vehicles and repairs engines, brakes and electronics. Route: Skilled trade. Time: About 3 to 4 years.
- [How to become an AC and Refrigeration Technician in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/ac-refrigeration-technician/): An AC and refrigeration technician installs and repairs air conditioners, fridges and cold rooms. Route: Skilled trade. Time: About 2 to 3 years.
- [How to become a Phone and Laptop Repair Technician in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/phone-repair-technician/): A repair technician fixes screens, batteries, charging ports and software problems on phones and laptops. Route: Skilled trade. Time: About 1 to 2 years.
- [How to become a Fashion Designer and Tailor in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/fashion-designer/): A fashion designer creates and sews clothes that fit well and look good. Route: Skilled trade. Time: About 1 to 3 years.
- [How to become a Hairstylist in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/hairstylist/): A hairstylist braids, styles and cares for hair and scalp. Route: Skilled trade. Time: About 1 to 2 years.
- [How to become a Barber in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/barber/): A barber cuts and shapes hair and beards cleanly and safely. Route: Skilled trade. Time: About 1 to 2 years.
- [How to become a Makeup Artist in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/makeup-artist/): A makeup artist prepares people for weddings, events, film and photos. Route: Skilled trade. Time: About 6 months to 2 years.
- [How to become a Chef and Caterer in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/chef/): A chef plans and cooks food for restaurants, hotels and events. Route: Skilled trade. Time: About 1 to 3 years.
- [How to become a Baker in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/baker/): A baker makes bread, cakes and pastries, measuring carefully every time. Route: Skilled trade. Time: About 1 to 2 years.
- [How to become a Carpenter and Furniture Maker in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/carpenter/): A carpenter builds furniture, doors, roofs and cabinets from wood. Route: Skilled trade. Time: About 2 to 4 years.
- [How to become a Bricklayer and Mason in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/bricklayer/): A bricklayer builds walls and foundations with blocks, bricks and concrete. Route: Skilled trade. Time: About 2 to 3 years.
- [How to become a Tiler in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/tiler/): A tiler lays floor and wall tiles so that surfaces are level, waterproof and beautiful. Route: Skilled trade. Time: About 1 to 2 years.
- [How to become a Painter and Decorator in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/painter/): A painter prepares and paints buildings, and advises on colours and finishes. Route: Skilled trade. Time: About 1 to 2 years.
- [How to become a Photographer and Videographer in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/photographer/): A photographer or videographer captures events, products and stories in pictures and film. Route: Skilled trade. Time: About 1 to 2 years.
- [How to become a Shoemaker and Leather Worker in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/shoemaker/): A shoemaker designs and makes shoes, sandals, bags and belts. Route: Skilled trade. Time: About 1 to 3 years.
- [How to become a CCTV and Security Systems Installer in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/cctv-installer/): A security systems installer fits cameras, alarms and access control for homes and businesses. Route: Skilled trade. Time: About 1 to 2 years.
- [How to become a Musician or Sound Engineer in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/musician-sound-engineer/): A musician performs or writes music; a sound engineer records and mixes it so it sounds right. Route: Skilled trade. Time: Skills grow over many years.
- [How to become an Athlete or Sports Coach in Nigeria](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/sports-coach/): An athlete competes; a coach trains others to play well and stay fit and safe. Route: Polytechnic or College. Time: 3 to 4 years for NCE or degree; badges take less.

## Tools
- [What can I become with my subjects?](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/subjects/): tick your subjects, see matching careers
- [All careers by route](https://naija-career-compass-ai.vercel.app/careers/)
